features.description: Reusable skills templates for the selected AI tool.
Reusable command templates for the selected AI tool.
Opt-in guidance to prefer structural search (code graph / LSP / index MCP) over plain text search when available. Default off; references stay no-op when disabled.

Opt-in opsx-prototype skill that turns prototype links / screenshots / descriptions into structured requirements for opsx-analysis. Default off; depends on optional external browser/visual tools and degrades gracefully. No credentials are built in. Enable with `init --feature prototype`.
